stateController.notes: HostTodayScreen and HostEventsScreen are independent route edges with separate route state and controllers. Today owns its bounded command-centre feed, live-first spotlight, event-identified attention, and Later projection. Events owns paginated schedule/history inventory through HostEventsTimelineController. Both consume shared event and organizer repositories without importing each other's presentation controller. Today has no personalization: the boards fix its order.

composition.currentLayout: HostTodayScreen is the direct Today route edge: a CatchRoot and CatchScreen with the tab-home top bar, and the provider-free HostTodayBody below it. Compact and medium windows stack tonight's poster and its actions, Needs you, This week and Last 30 days; expanded windows use the feed pane layout with the poster, actions and week beside Needs you and the stats. HostAttentionPolicy derives supported work from backend facts, while Events exclusively owns create, repeat, import, draft-resume, schedule, and history inventory. No speculative recent-activity feed is rendered without an authoritative source.
composition.targetLayout: Complete. Keep Today as the independent time-sensitive command centre and Events as the durable lifecycle inventory. Preserve their separate route, state, view-model, and controller boundaries, shared repository-owned event facts, and the original adaptive Catch navigation chrome.

sections.name: Host Today command centre
sections.currentOwner: HostTodayBody with parts from the events and insights contexts
sections.migration: Complete. Today renders one current-event decision layer, every supported time-sensitive attention item, up to three additional events inside the named seven-day horizon, and View full calendar plus Dress Rehearsal handoffs. Compact layouts use a quiet outlined spotlight and a vertical stack; capable layouts remove the spotlight container and add a fixed attention pane. Event creation remains Events-owned and Recent signals stays absent until an authoritative feed exists.
